DXC Technology is hiring an Analyst I Software Engineering to bridge business stakeholders and technical teams and ensure software solutions meet organizational goals and technical requirements. The role focuses on requirements gathering, system analysis and design, quality assurance, and communicating between business and development teams.

Responsibilities
Gather and document clear project goals and technical specifications by meeting with business leaders and users
Analyze existing software architectures to identify performance issues, security gaps, and optimization opportunities
Create detailed functional designs, user stories, and Software Requirement Specification (SRS) documents
Translate complex technical concepts for non-technical teams and communicate business needs clearly to developers
Participate in code reviews to ensure quality and adherence to technical standards
Coordinate defect tracking with quality assurance teams
Troubleshoot and resolve production issues
Serve as a cross-functional liaison between business and technical teams
